producer_report.summary: The mistake report now shows each class of work's mistakes before and after its recorded improvement, plus a per-month count. The new `mistake_trends` in status.rs sets the improvement as the earliest Recorded introspection with a non-empty prevention linked to a mistake of that class. Mistakes at or before its time count as before, later ones as after. `display::mistakes` prints a `mistakes trend <class>: before N, after M ...` line per class. A class with no improvement prints `no improvement recorded, N so far`. docs/spec.toml OLY-1-07 now names the mechanism and ends its measure with `status: mistakes`. CHANGELOG.md has an entry. I added one unit test and one display test. The other targeted tests, clippy, fmt, the policy scan and the mirrors test pass. One unrelated drain test fails in the full athena-cli run.
